name: getonbrd-mcp
description: Get on Board (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Public API ('No authentication required'): GET /api/v0/search/jobs with query, remote, page ('starting at 1') and per_page (maximum 120); expand=["company"] is sent so the company name is inline. country_code takes alpha-3 codes (example 'CHL') and there is no free-text place filter, so location and country are not sent. JSON:API hits: id is the job slug, attributes.description is HTML, attributes.published_at is a Unix epoch integer (raw), min/max_salary are integers with no documented currency, meta.total_pages is the only count (no total).
